title: Jordan Walke, Facebook, and React's 2013 Debut
explainer: React was built by Facebook engineer Jordan Walke and quietly shipped inside Facebook's News Feed in 2011 and Instagram's website in 2012 before Facebook open-sourced it at a JavaScript conference in May 2013. It arrived at a moment when many developers were skeptical of mixing markup into JavaScript - what became JSX - yet the component model it introduced became the template nearly every later front-end framework followed. The component-based thinking this lesson teaches traces back to that specific, dated decision rather than being an obvious or inevitable design.
